# Final Review & Quality Assurance Prompt

Please conduct a thorough final review of all the changes you just made. Go through each file systematically and verify the following:

## 1. Accuracy & Completeness Check
- **File Paths**: Verify all file paths are correct and match the intended directory structure
- **Content Alignment**: Ensure all content accurately reflects the @V-Borg project requirements from the original prompt
- **Consistency**: Check that terminology, naming conventions, and concepts are consistent across all files
- **Completeness**: Confirm all requested deliverables have been created and nothing is missing

## 2. Technical Validation
- **Syntax**: Verify all markdown syntax is correct (headers, links, code blocks, lists)
- **Code Examples**: Check that any code snippets are syntactically correct and follow project standards
- **File References**: Ensure all internal links and file references point to actual files/sections
- **Template Structure**: Confirm all templates follow the established patterns from the reference materials

## 3. Content Quality Review
- **Clarity**: Ensure all explanations are clear and easy to understand
- **Detail Level**: Verify appropriate level of detail for each section (not too sparse, not overwhelming)
- **Professional Tone**: Check that writing maintains a professional, technical documentation tone
- **Action Items**: Confirm all task briefs have clear, actionable requirements

## 4. Project-Specific Validation
- **Beehive Theme**: Verify consistent use of bee/swarm/hive metaphors throughout
- **@V-Borg Identity**: Ensure the project maintains its distinct identity separate from @V HQ
- **Integration Ready**: Confirm documentation reflects proper integration as a Nuxt layer
- **Roadmap Alignment**: Check that all components align with the proposed development phases

## 5. Cross-Reference Check
- **Template Consistency**: Verify prompt templates match the actual project needs
- **Roadmap Coherence**: Ensure milestones and timelines are realistic and sequential
- **Task Dependencies**: Check that task briefs properly reference dependencies and prerequisites
- **Architecture Alignment**: Confirm all technical decisions align with the stated architecture

## Review Process
1. Go through each file you created/modified
2. Read it carefully as if you're seeing it for the first time
3. Check against the original requirements
4. Note any discrepancies, errors, or improvements needed
5. Provide a summary of your findings

## Response Format
Please provide:
```
## Files Reviewed
- [List each file you reviewed]

## Issues Found & Corrected
- [Any errors you found and how you fixed them]

## Verification Checklist
- [ ] All file paths are correct
- [ ] Content matches requirements
- [ ] Terminology is consistent
- [ ] Markdown syntax is valid
- [ ] Code examples are correct
- [ ] Internal references work
- [ ] Professional tone maintained
- [ ] Beehive theme consistent
- [ ] Integration approach clear
- [ ] Roadmap is logical
- [ ] Tasks are actionable

## Final Assessment
[Overall assessment of the deliverables and any remaining concerns]
```

Take your time with this review - quality and accuracy are more important than speed.
